dialogues.jp: 「さて……どこで食うかな」
dialogues.en: "Now, where should I eat..."
dialogues.text: "Now, where should I eat..."

dialogues.jp:
焼きそばパンとコロッケパンを、ぽんと跳ね上
げる。
dialogues.en: I carried some yakisoba bread and croquette bread with me.
dialogues.text: I carried some yakisoba bread and croquette bread with me.

dialogues.jp:
昼休みの購買と来たら、バーゲンセールのおば
ちゃん達顔負けのバトルっぷりだ。それを勝ち
抜いてゲットした、人気のパンだった。
dialogues.en:
The two breads were on a bargain sale, and I had to fight
through several students to grab them. They're a popular
item.
dialogues.text:
The two breads were on a bargain sale, and I had to fight
through several students to grab them. They're a popular
item.

dialogues.jp: 「……牛みたいにくちゃくちゃと味わおう」
dialogues.en: "...I bet a cow could graze here for a long time."
dialogues.text: "...I bet a cow could graze here for a long time."

dialogues.jp:
日当たりのいいベンチに目を付け、そこに向か
う。
dialogues.en:
I find a good bench with some sun shining onto it, and
approach it.
dialogues.text:
I find a good bench with some sun shining onto it, and
approach it.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉君、やりすぎですよ〜」
dialogues.en: "...Overdoing it a bit, Asakura-kun~?"
dialogues.text: "...Overdoing it a bit, Asakura-kun~?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうか」
dialogues.en: "Maybe."
dialogues.text: "Maybe."

dialogues.jp: さくっと腰を上げ、隣に腰を下ろす。
dialogues.en: I sat next to her, putting the bag down next to me.
dialogues.text: I sat next to her, putting the bag down next to me.

dialogues.jp:
ちなみにさっきは、ことりの膝に座っていたの
だ。
dialogues.en: Not like there's any other place to sit, besides on her lap.
dialogues.text: Not like there's any other place to sit, besides on her lap.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「重いですよ、朝倉君。潰れちゃうかと思いま
　した」
dialogues.en:
"That's really a lot, Asakura-kun. You must've spent a lot
on that."
dialogues.text:
"That's really a lot, Asakura-kun. You must've spent a lot
on that."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「太ってはいないと思うんだけどな」
dialogues.en:
"It'd be worth it. I won't get fat on it or anything
anyway."
dialogues.text:
"It'd be worth it. I won't get fat on it or anything
anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ああいうのは、女の子が男の子にするからい
　いんですよ」
dialogues.en: "Guys have it lucky, they don't have to worry about that."
dialogues.text: "Guys have it lucky, they don't have to worry about that."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……覚えておこう」
dialogues.en: "...Yeah, pretty much."
dialogues.text: "...Yeah, pretty much."

dialogues.jp:
役に立つ時が来るのかどうか、それは定かでは
ないが。
dialogues.en:
I probably should've said something helpful then, but I
couldn't think of anything.
dialogues.text:
I probably should've said something helpful then, but I
couldn't think of anything.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「３年後ぐらいには、朝倉君にもきっと、可愛
　い恋人が出来ていますよ」
dialogues.en: "Within 3 years, you'd surely find a cute girlfriend!"
dialogues.text: "Within 3 years, you'd surely find a cute girlfriend!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "...3 years?"
dialogues.text: "...3 years?"

dialogues.jp:
微妙に具体的な数字だな。どっから出てきたん
だ？
dialogues.en:
An exact figure for a cloudy subject... where'd the whole
subject come from anyway?
dialogues.text:
An exact figure for a cloudy subject... where'd the whole
subject come from anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あ……もしかしたら、３日後かもしれません
　けど」
dialogues.en: "Aah... maybe even within 3 days?"
dialogues.text: "Aah... maybe even within 3 days?"

dialogues.jp: 何の事やら。
dialogues.en: What the hell's going on.
dialogues.text: What the hell's going on.

dialogues.jp:
「で？　ことりは、何をぼうっ、としてたん
　だ？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? Kotori, what's up with you today?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? Kotori, what's up with you today?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ぼうっ、とはしてませんよ。お昼ご飯です」
dialogues.en: "Oh, nothing. Just having my lunch!"
dialogues.text: "Oh, nothing. Just having my lunch!"

dialogues.jp:
そう言って、ちんまりとした弁当箱を膝の上に
置いた。
dialogues.en: She placed her lunchbox on her lap.
dialogues.text: She placed her lunchbox on her lap.

dialogues.jp: 「一緒してもいい？」
dialogues.en: "May I join you?"
dialogues.text: "May I join you?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Sure."
dialogues.text: "Sure."

dialogues.jp:
その笑顔に、ポケットに突っ込んでいた焼きそ
ばパンを取り出す。
dialogues.en:
With her acceptance and smile, I take the yakisoba bread out
from my pocket.
dialogues.text:
With her acceptance and smile, I take the yakisoba bread out
from my pocket.

dialogues.jp: ……うわ、形が崩れてるな。
dialogues.en: ...Gah, it's all smushed up.
dialogues.text: ...Gah, it's all smushed up.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、味には関係ない……と」
dialogues.en:
"Well, as long as it tastes good, how it looks shouldn't
matter..."
dialogues.text:
"Well, as long as it tastes good, how it looks shouldn't
matter..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Uhm, that's..."
dialogues.text: "Uhm, that's..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Hmm?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm?"

dialogues.jp:
口をもごもごとさせながら、ことりに顔を向け
る。
dialogues.en: Chewing the bread from my first bite, I look towards Kotori.
dialogues.text: Chewing the bread from my first bite, I look towards Kotori.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「珍しいの、ゲット出来たんですね」
dialogues.en: "That's amazing, it's usually impossible to get that."
dialogues.text: "That's amazing, it's usually impossible to get that."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「おう。壮絶なバトルの末な」
dialogues.en:
"Yup, it was a battle of epic proportions to acquire this
treasure."
dialogues.text:
"Yup, it was a battle of epic proportions to acquire this
treasure."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「私は、食べたことないですね……」
dialogues.en: "I've never eaten that before..."
dialogues.text: "I've never eaten that before..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「一口、くれますか？」
dialogues.en: "May I have a bite?"
dialogues.text: "May I have a bite?"

dialogues.jp: 普通の焼きそばパンなんだけどな……。
dialogues.en: It's just a normal yakisoba bread...
dialogues.text: It's just a normal yakisoba bread...

dialogues.jp: そうだな……
dialogues.en: Oh well...
dialogues.text: Oh well...

dialogues.jp: ◆焼きそばパンあげる？◆
dialogues.en: ◆Yakisoba Bread Gift?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Yakisoba Bread Gift?◆

dialogues.jp: 中庭にてことりと一緒に昼食を取った。
dialogues.en: I ate lunch with Kotori in the courtyard.
dialogues.text: I ate lunch with Kotori in the courtyard.

dialogues.jp:
任意の数字を書き、その下に移動させるファイ
ル俺が焼きそばパンを取り出すと、ことりは、
一口欲しいと言ってきた。
dialogues.en:
When I took out my Yakisoba bread, Kotori requested for a
bite.
dialogues.text:
When I took out my Yakisoba bread, Kotori requested for a
bite.
